title: Replenishment Loading by Earned Wage Access Remittance Method — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service
content:
**Clause.** An employer whose Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement is live and whose remittances Paystride takes by ACH debit authorization adds 10 percent to a replenishment debit on its Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service, an employer whose live agreement remits by another method adds 5 percent, and an employer with no live agreement adds nothing for its agreement.

The agreement's status and remittance method — how the employer remits deducted amounts — are read from the employer's Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement record.

| The employer's agreement | Loading |
|---|---|
| live, remittances by ACH debit authorization | 10 percent |
| live, remittances by employer ACH credit | 5 percent |
| live, remittances by wire | 5 percent |
| no live agreement | nothing |

An agreement in any status other than live adds nothing, whatever its remittance method.
